# Security CI job. Merge into .github/workflows/ci.yml.
  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - name: Secret scan
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} }
      - name: Dependency audit (fail on high)
        run: cd app && npm ci && npm audit --audit-level=high
      - name: Forbid service-role key in client code
        run: "! grep -rn 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE' app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v 'server' "
      - name: Forbid student-record fields in analytics events
        run: "! grep -rnE 'track\\(.*(grade|gpa|ssn|student_id|dob)' app/src"
      - name: RLS + command + AI red-team tests
        run: npx supabase start && npx vitest run tests/rls.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/commands.test.ts tests/ai-redteam.test.ts
